items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: We had done another national headlining tour with our good friends Goose

ctx.x: You know definitely I mean on a personal level I think we’re definitely all aware of it, some focus on that more than others. But I think in general we’re all very aware of that. You know when it comes to the business side and the growth of the band it’s hard to say. We’re going to continue to just keep doing the things that have gotten us this far and surrounded us with people that have allowed us to continue this journey. I know on a more musical side I think you know we’ve reached a level over the last couple…

There are a couple of aspects to that question from the business side of things. There’s always unexpected things that you never could predict, like Covid. The pandemic. We were kind of cruising up towards growing bigger and bigger. We had done another national headlining tour with our good friends Goose and then the pandemic hit and we kind of settled down. They started working on certain things and hit a moment and they are playing arenas now. And for us the pandemic kind of allowed us to re-look into how ©…

we were growing and approaching it, and you know I wouldn’t say it interrupted our growth because it helped re-focus it in a different kind of way, but it did change the trajectory for that period of time and allowed us to kind of look — kind of take the heat off of ourselves and we started writing more together, using remote applications where we can share our music that we still use to this day even though we still practice a couple of times every week when we’re home. So that opened up that avenue of writing…
